instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Residential renovation and energy retrofit company performing deep energy upgrades including external insulation, heat pump installation, and solar PV integration. Completing ~80 projects per year. Seeking to standardize energy audit workflows with tablet-based inspection and automated grant application filing. A tight-knit operation where everyone wears multiple hats. We have no dedicated innovation budget — improvements happen opportunistically when the team identifies a clear bottleneck affecting our core operations or customer experience.
answers.pastInitiatives: Our digital transformation program is in its third year with a dedicated transformation office reporting to the CEO. We have completed an ERP migration to the cloud, rolled out a company-wide data warehouse with self-service BI dashboards, and established a center of excellence for process automation using RPA and low-code tools. The program has delivered €2.4M in annualized cost savings to date.
answers.strategicGoals: We are the incumbent market leader but face increasing pressure from 2 well-funded new entrants who are undercutting our pricing and offering a more modern customer experience. Our priority is defending our installed base — reducing churn, strengthening switching costs, and matching the digital experience our competitors offer without triggering a destructive price war.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.
answers.additionalContext: Upcoming changes to industry-specific safety and certification standards will require us to recertify our entire product line over the next 2 years. The recertification process is expensive and time-consuming. We need innovation ideas that either accelerate the recertification workflow itself or deliver sufficient business value to justify the combined certification-plus-innovation investment.

input.changes_since_last: Hired 7 new team members. Launched customer feedback pilot. Budget for innovation increased 10%.

opportunities.title: Standardize and Automate Energy Audit & Grant Filing Workflows
opportunities.rationale: Leverage the established data warehouse and CoE capabilities to build standardized, digital workflows for field audits. This reduces reliance on manual processes, speeds up service delivery, and directly strengthens switching costs by making your process superior to competitors.

first_actions: Define core audit workflow steps with end-users (site managers).
Develop a low-code prototype for tablet data capture integrated with the existing ERP/Data Warehouse.
Map all required grant application inputs to standardized digital forms.
resources_needed: Pilot group of 2-3 field staff for testing
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in average audit completion time by 30%; Error rate reduction in grant application filing to <5%.
milestones: Workflow diagram finalized and signed off (Month 1)
Prototype functional with internal testing team (Month 3)
Pilot deployment across 2 distinct project types (Month 5)

opportunities.title: Establish Proactive Compliance & Product Recertification Program
opportunities.rationale: The mandatory industry recertification is a critical, time-sensitive risk. Developing a structured program now (rather than reacting to deadlines) minimizes operational disruption and maintains market credibility while simultaneously identifying potential technology improvements that can be monetized.

first_actions: Engage external compliance consultant to map all existing product lines against new standards.
Create a centralized, project-based timeline tracking the recertification status of each SKU/service line.
Identify which certifications require digital evidence capture (e.g., photo logs, specific test results) to streamline future processes.
resources_needed: Dedicated administrative time for documentation organization
execution_plan.success_metric: 100% visibility into recertification status and defined mitigation plan for the top 3 most critical product lines within 9 months.
milestones: Recertification roadmap signed off by leadership (Month 4)

next_steps.action: Assign a senior owner (Director level) to 'own' the overall innovation pipeline, ensuring dedicated time and strategic prioritization for both workflow automation and recertification.
Formalize a dedicated 20% time allocation for the two generalist developers specifically to the CoE/Digital Transformation efforts, protecting them from ad-hoc operational requests.
Develop a dedicated budget line item specifically tracking 'Compliance Risk Mitigation' costs associated with recertification and potential technology upgrades needed to meet new standards.

key_weaknesses: Resource Contention: The team remains heavily dependent on generalist developers whose time is pulled into urgent operational tasks, inhibiting sustained innovation.
Strategic Oversight Gap: Lack of a single owner responsible for translating strategic goals (market defense) into dedicated, funded, and executed process improvements.
Culture/Time Barrier: Despite new hires and increased budget visibility, the default mode remains opportunistic problem-solving rather than proactive transformation.

improvements: Significant Digital Backbone Built: Completion of ERP migration, Data Warehouse implementation, and CoE establishment provides a robust platform for future automation.
Increased Resources/Funding: 7 new hires combined with the increased innovation budget (8%) signal organizational commitment to growth.
Market Intelligence Established: The customer feedback pilot ensures that development efforts are grounded in real user needs.
persistent_gaps: Dedicated Capacity: Resource allocation remains volatile; the core ability to execute complex projects is bottlenecked by generalist developer availability.
Strategic Mandate: Efforts are still reactive. The company has strong tools but lacks a consistently enforced, strategic mandate that forces transformation over maintenance.
achieved_milestones: Successfully migrated key operational functions to the cloud ERP system.
Established self-service BI dashboards allowing for data-driven decision making across departments.
Achieved €2.4M in annualized cost savings from process automation to date.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Significant improvement in digital process maturity and financial commitment (budget increase from 3% to 8%). The established CoE proves the capability for large-scale automation, moving the organization from theoretical planning to operational execution.
